Part of #31527 (ADR-0150). #31527 holds its maximum of 100 sub-issues (76 closed), so new ADR-0150 children hang here. The closed children stay on #31527 as its progress view; none is detached.

## Where a new ADR-0150 card hangs

1. A follow-up that has a source card (a review nit, an out-of-scope finding, a card that says "Follow-up of #N") nests under that source card. This is the epic's standing rule.
2. A child with no source card nests here.
3. Each card still says `Part of #31527` in its first lines, so a search on the epic finds it.

## Phase 2 scope

- Same-name edges found while the families' backstops (B #31696–#31701) land: doors, readers and stores that still answer by name alone once two packages of two namespaces hold one name.
- Skills and docs lines owed by the families (ADR-0150 D9).
- Close-out: A #31685 (ADR status lines), and the reconciliation of #31527's milestone table.

Release line: the maintainer's ruling 6824949405 on #31527 governs. p1 cards and cards that already have a PR are on the line; unstarted p2 cards and review follow-ups are parked with `pm:on-hold`. Same-family edge cards with no first-party use are folded into one PR per family when dispatched.

## Children

Children of this card are listed in its sub-issues panel. Each lane works its own card. The epic seat (`epic:#31527#1`) dispatches the server lane's cards and does the red-line reads.
